stocks.name: Boeing
stocks.query: Boeing (stock OR earnings OR production OR FAA OR orders)

research.summary: The November 20 oversight audit and unresolved layoffs add uncertainty. The audit is not itself a new production ban. A three-month turnaround thesis needs delivery and cash-flow evidence.
research.summaryZh: 11月20日的新审计和后续裁员不确定性增加了执行风险。审计本身不代表新增停产令。三个月内能否改善，应以交付、产量和现金流证据判断。
research.enter: Consider a small staged entry only after delivery trends improve and management supports its production and cash-flow outlook. Orders alone are insufficient.
research.enterZh: 交付趋势改善、管理层能够支持产量和现金流展望后，再考虑小额分批建仓；仅有订单消息不足以支持买入。
research.exit: Reassess if output milestones slip again, new operating restrictions appear, or cash-flow expectations deteriorate.
research.exitZh: 若增产节点再推迟、出现新的经营限制或现金流预期恶化，应重新评估并考虑降低敞口。

bondExposure.summary: Rates and credit spreads matter through new borrowing, refinancing and financing available to airline customers. Evaluate this alongside actual production, deliveries and cash generation.
bondExposure.summaryZh: 利率和信用利差会通过新融资、再融资，以及航空客户的融资条件传导。需要与实际产量、交付和现金流一起判断。
bondExposure.watch: Debt maturities, fixed versus floating rates, liquidity, credit-rating actions and aircraft delivery cash receipts.
bondExposure.watchZh: 核对债务到期、固定与浮动利率比例、流动性、评级变化，以及交付回款。
bondExposure.caution: A Treasury rally does not guarantee lower company borrowing costs if credit spreads widen. Existing fixed-rate coupons do not automatically increase.
bondExposure.cautionZh: 若信用利差扩大，国债上涨也不保证公司融资成本降低；存量固定利率债务的票息不会自动增加。

stocks.name: Autodesk
stocks.query: Autodesk (stock OR earnings OR guidance OR Forma OR Fusion)

research.summary: The next scheduled catalyst is the November 24 earnings call, announced November 2. This is older information, not a new 72-hour announcement. The August quarter showed 16% revenue growth; the coming outlook matters more than a headline beat.
research.summaryZh: 最近的已确认节点是11月24日财报电话会，11月2日已公告，不属于最近72小时的新公告。8月披露的季度收入增长16%；本次更应看后续指引和现金流，而非仅看盈利超预期。
research.enter: If results and forward guidance support growth and cash conversion, consider staged entry after the earnings reaction settles. Check the new valuation before entering.
research.enterZh: 若业绩和未来指引支持增长与现金回收，可等财报后价格反应稳定，再结合当时估值分批考虑；不建议仅因财报临近而押注。
research.exit: Reassess on a guidance cut, weaker underlying demand or deterioration in cash-flow expectations.
research.exitZh: 若下调指引、基础需求转弱或现金流展望恶化，应撤回偏积极判断。

sources.title: Fiscal 2027 Q2 results and guidance
sources.titleZh: 财年2027第二季业绩与指引（较早背景）

bondExposure.summary: Higher real yields can reduce the present value of future growth. Tighter financing for construction and manufacturing customers can also affect demand for design software.
bondExposure.summaryZh: 实际收益率上升可能降低未来增长的现值；建筑和制造业客户融资收紧，也可能影响设计软件需求。
bondExposure.watch: 10-year real yields, customer demand, renewals, forward guidance and free cash flow. Separate changes in valuation multiples from changes in the business.
bondExposure.watchZh: 观察10年期实际收益率、客户需求、续约、未来指引和自由现金流，区分估值倍数变化与业务变化。
bondExposure.caution: Lower yields can help valuation, but weakening demand or guidance can outweigh that support.
bondExposure.cautionZh: 收益率下降可能支持估值，但需求或指引转弱仍可能抵消这一支持。

stocks.name: Alcoa
stocks.query: Alcoa (stock OR earnings OR aluminum OR alumina OR acquisition)

research.stanceZh: 谨慎，等待价格与利润信号
research.summary: The next verified company event is the December 2 Citi conference, announced November 18 and outside the 72-hour news window. This review did not establish a new company announcement within the window. A falling share price alone is not a buying thesis.
research.summaryZh: 最近已核实的公司节点是12月2日花旗会议，公告于11月18日，已超出72小时窗口。本次研究未核实到窗口内新的重大公司公告。股价下跌本身不能构成买入理由。
research.enter: Consider entry only if aluminum/alumina pricing and cost guidance support improving margins, with the December 2 outlook providing a near-term checkpoint.
research.enterZh: 只有铝及氧化铝价格、成本指引共同支持利润改善时，再考虑介入；12月2日的经营展望是近期复核节点。
research.exit: Reassess if realized prices weaken faster than costs, financing pressure increases, or guidance disappoints.
research.exitZh: 若实际售价下降快于成本、融资压力增加或指引不及预期，应重新评估并控制敞口。

bondExposure.summary: Credit conditions can affect financing and the industrial demand behind aluminum. Combine the bond backdrop with aluminum/alumina prices, energy costs and operating margins.
bondExposure.summaryZh: 信用条件既影响融资，也关联铝需求背后的工业活动。需将债市背景与铝、氧化铝价格、能源成本和经营利润率一起看。
bondExposure.watch: Credit-spread direction, borrowing terms, debt maturity profile, realized commodity prices and unit costs.
bondExposure.watchZh: 观察信用利差方向、融资条款、债务到期结构、实际商品售价和单位成本。
bondExposure.caution: Falling Treasury yields caused by recession fears are not necessarily favorable for a cyclical producer. Commodity margins remain essential.
bondExposure.cautionZh: 衰退担忧引起的国债收益率下降，对周期性生产商未必有利；商品利润仍是关键。

stocks.name: UnitedHealth Group
stocks.query: (UnitedHealth OR UnitedHealthcare OR Optum) (stock OR earnings OR Medicare OR medical costs OR DOJ)

bondExposure.summary: Rates affect both investment income and the fair value of its bond portfolio, as well as debt financing. The net effect depends on maturities, reinvestment, hedges and asset/liability matching.
bondExposure.summaryZh: 利率既影响投资收益和债券组合公允价值，也影响债务融资。净影响取决于期限、再投资、对冲和资产负债匹配。
bondExposure.watch: Investment income, interest expense, unrealized bond gains/losses and rate sensitivity disclosed in filings, alongside medical costs and operating guidance.
bondExposure.watchZh: 核对报表中的投资收益、利息支出、债券未实现损益和利率敏感性，同时关注医疗成本及经营指引。
bondExposure.caution: Higher reinvestment yields may help income while existing fixed-rate bonds lose market value. An insurance company does not automatically benefit from rising rates.
bondExposure.cautionZh: 更高的再投资收益率可能增加收入，但存量固定利率债券的市值也可能下降，不能简单认为利率上升就利好保险公司。
